purpose: Define how an approved cumulative assessment fragment maps individual Exercise Builder question versions to Curriculum v2 outcomes and how submitted/reviewed answers become first-class outcome evidence.
principles: Fragment-level metadata determines the assessment form, primary axis, transfer level, independence family and programme compatibility; question-level mappings determine which scored answer may provide evidence for which outcome.
Do not copy an entire exercise score onto every declared outcome. Evidence is captured from mapped scored questions.
A question may support more than one outcome only when each mapping is explicit and pedagogically defensible.
Primary question evidence must target an outcome on the fragment primary axis; supporting evidence may target declared secondary axes.
Only outcomes required in the learner's active enrollment scope produce readiness evidence.
Manual-production answers remain pending_review until a teacher review produces a score; pending evidence is never converted to zero.
The same attempt-question/outcome/mode combination has one stable evidence key so teacher review updates the observation instead of duplicating it.
Evidence from repeated attempts keeps the fragment form_family_key so the future readiness calculator can prevent best-score shopping and count independent forms correctly.
This contract captures evidence only. It does not itself select fragments, calculate readiness or change learner-facing readiness.

fragment_registration.approved_fragment_gate: status=approved requires a published Exercise Builder exercise, approved exercise version and approved mapped question versions.
fragment_registration.question_membership_gate: Every mapped question_version_id must belong to the registered exercise_version_id through a fixed section question or the exact pool version used by that exercise version.
fragment_registration.outcome_axis_gate: Every declared outcome must belong to the fragment primary axis or a declared secondary axis, and at least one declared outcome must belong to the primary axis.
fragment_registration.mutation_policy: Only admin RPCs may register/update fragments; authenticated users have read-only table access.

question_mapping_rules: outcome_id must be declared by the fragment and approved in Curriculum v2.
assessment_mode must be declared by the fragment and active in the canonical assessment-mode catalogue.
Primary evidence may only target the fragment primary axis.
Every declared outcome and every declared assessment mode must appear in at least one question mapping.
evidence_weight is greater than zero and at most one.

evidence_capture.scope_gate: The mapped outcome must exist as required=true in recovery_enrollment_outcomes for the Recovery session enrollment.
evidence_capture.automatic_answer: A scored grading_result with max_points > 0 creates/updates a valid 0-100 evidence observation.
evidence_capture.manual_answer: A missing/pending grading_result creates/updates pending_review evidence with score=null; a later teacher review updates the same evidence key to valid.
evidence_capture.axis_rule: The outcome's own competence axis is stored on the evidence row; fragment primary/supporting role is retained in rubric metadata.
evidence_capture.independence_rule: The fragment form_family_key is preserved unchanged on all question-level observations from that form.
